verdict.rationale: Org-level administration is a fair question for an enterprise agent product, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no dots capability for a team-admin to manage members, permissions, or data policies. What the pack does show doesn't count: per-user action rules (dots-docs-20) are an adjacent user control, inherited ChatGPT app permissions (dots-docs-21) are a host-platform feature, and a vague mention of 'permitted local repositories' on an enterprise page (dots-docs-25) doesn't document any admin tooling.
